title: Immerse yourself in the sea of ​​clouds in Hanoi

html:
When it comes to cloud hunting, many tourists immediately think of the Northwest mountains or Da Lat, but few people know that in Hanoi, tourists can also immerse themselves in the sea of ​​floating clouds.

The cloud hunting spot that is being hunted by backpackers must immediately mention Ba Vi National Park, the green lung of the capital Hanoi, the most beautiful is when dawn comes, visitors can admire the scenery under the rising sun or after the rain, the weather covers the clouds like a beautiful picture.

Ba Vi National Park is different from other tourist attractions in the capital or other cities, from the evening of the previous day to about 9 o’clock the next day, the temperature here is relatively cool, sometimes chilly, the fresh air is very suitable for cloud hunting and sightseeing, especially resort tours at Ba Vi National Park.

Traveling to Ba Vi from April to October is a great place to escape the sun, because Ba Vi is a place with a beautiful landscape and cool weather, and this is also an opportunity for visitors to immerse themselves in the sea of ​​clouds and capture beautiful photos.

Many tourists who love to take virtual photos to have beautiful photos have traveled to Ba Vi from 3am to Ba Vi National Park to watch the sunrise, and this is the time many young people choose to take virtual photos when traveling to Hanoi

To get to Ba Vi National Park from the center of Hanoi, visitors can go in the direction of Thang Long Avenue or via National Highway 32, or if visitors take a bus from My Dinh, visitors take bus 74, 71 and at the end take bus 110 to Ba Vi National Park.
